text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Large trials in vitamin D-replete adults found no effect of supplementation on cancer, cardiovascular events, or type 2 diabetes.","cited_pids":["fbce4d7a6120#3"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Large trials in vitamin D-replete adults found no effect of supplementation on bone density or falls.","cited_pids":["fbce4d7a6120#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The Finnish vitamin D trial found no lower rate of major cardiovascular events or invasive cancer in older adults taking vitamin D.","cited_pids":["0dafa2c8c11c#3"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"The VITAL trial found no reduction in fractures among generally healthy midlife and older adults taking vitamin D.","cited_pids":["d8b33533d51c#3"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A meta-analysis found that vitamin D supplementation did not reduce all-cause mortality.","cited_pids":["81282aae0b32#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A meta-analysis found that vitamin D supplementation reduced cancer death by 16%.","cited_pids":["81282aae0b32#2"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"The Endocrine Society guideline suggests empiric vitamin D supplementation for adults aged 75 and older for mortality reduction.","cited_pids":["8279771cfc3d#4"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"The Endocrine Society guideline suggests vitamin D supplementation for people with high-risk prediabetes.","cited_pids":["8279771cfc3d#4"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Some guideline groups still recommend vitamin D supplementation despite reviews finding it ineffective.","cited_pids":["9c98e4515e3d#0"]}]}
